note: Engine cases for the Reg CF CORPUS projection (regcf-corpus.dmn) — the
deliverable R0 ('the execution is the exhibit', spec §6.2) names.
STATUS 2026-08-02 — 16 cases: the base case (REGENERATED for R12 + R13,
spec §15.12 / §16) plus 15 RELOCATION cases carrying the temporal truths of
the 15 rule-date-rebinding fixture decisions R12 dropped from the artifact
(ruling R-C, spec §15.12.1: 'the model owns the law under a date; the
harness owns the dates'). MEASURED the same day on both engines at the
R12/R13 tree plus this file, banners verbatim:
* KIE 8.44.0.Final: 'XSD valid; VALID clean; BUILD clean;
KIE 8.44.0.Final VERDICT: 1 file(s), 16 case(s), 0 error(s),
0 warning(s), 1072/1072 decision(s) SUCCEEDED, 1072/1072 value(s) as
expected, 224/224 service output value(s) as expected'
— the service clause value-checks every declared outputDecision of the
7 emitted decisionServices against the SAME expect pins, per case, with
each service fed its inputDecisions' computed values
(before R12/R13: VALID 16 error(s), evaluation refused).
* Camunda 8.7.6 (zeebe-dmn): 'PARSE ok: SEC Regulation Crowdfunding —
17 CFR Part 227 (67 decision(s));
Camunda 8.7.6 (zeebe-dmn) VERDICT: 1 file(s), 16 case(s), 1 parsed,
0 error(s), 1072/1072 decision(s) evaluated, 1072/1072 value(s) as
expected'
(before: PARSE INVALID on the raw-L4 deontic body, 0 parsed).
ACTIVATION CONTRACT, unchanged: every value below is derived from the L4
SOURCE (regcf.l4), cross-checked against its own #ASSERT directives, never
from a DMN engine's own output — a pin regenerated from the thing it pins
is vacuous. MEASURE before believing.
THE RELOCATION CASES (2026-08-02, ruling R-C). R12 dropped the 15
`EVAL UNDER RULES EFFECTIVE AT` fixture decisions (regcf.l4:1123-1236)
because a DRG has ONE global rule-date input and no scoped rebinding. Their
truths relocate HERE: each case sets RULES_EFFECTIVE_DATE to the fixture's
pinned date and delivers the fixture's scenario through the global
inputData — which works because of the very lowering D-PARAM-AS-INPUT and
D-BKM record (spec §6.2): every figure in the qualification cone flows
through λ-lifted closure parameters bound `name: name` to the GLOBAL
decisions, so the five `*_case_qualifies` decisions all compute THE SAME
value — the qualification of the GLOBAL world under the global rule date —
and pinning that value against the L4-evaluated qualification of the same
world exercises the relocated regime question end to end. Where a case
overrides a slot beyond the fixture's own variation (supplied=audited on
the W trio, amount=2000/9000/115000), the override exists to make every
OTHER limb of the conjunction true under that regime, so the pinned
true/false isolates exactly the limb the fixture asserted. The relocation
map, with the L4 ground truth each case re-verifies (all evaluated with the
built l4 binary on a copy of regcf.l4, 2026-08-02 — 140/140 assertions
satisfied including all 15 relocated #ASSERTs):
($3M). #ASSERTs: NOT/NOT/yes within the offering limit. Surfaces as
offering_maximum_in_a_12_month_period 1000000/1070000/5000000 and the
five qualifies pins false/false/true (all other limbs measured true:
supplied=audited covers the $3M audit tier; amount=2000 sits inside
the 2016 'lesser of' limit max(2000, 5% × 60000) = 3000).
* cut-point pair (2017-04-11 / 2017-04-12): base globals, date only.
#ASSERTs: 100000 / 107000, pinned directly on
income_or_net_worth_cut_point. The five qualifies pins are false on
both days for the same L4-evaluated reason: the base amount 5000
exceeds the pre-2021 'lesser of' limit max(min_inv, 5% × 60000) = 3000.
* I-3 pair (2022-06-01 / 2023-06-01): global investor = I-3
(110000/115000), amount = 9000, chosen between the two limits.
#ASSERTs: limit 11500 / 5750 — the 2022 adjustment HALVES this
investor's capacity by moving them across the (i)/(ii) limb boundary.
Surfaces as either_annual_income_or_net_worth_is_less_than_the_cut_point
false/true and the qualifies pins true/false (9000 ≤ 11500; 9000 > 5750).
* I-4 (2022-06-01): the closure regression. Global investor = I-4
limb-(ii) cap moved WITH the cut point in the same release. Surfaces as
qualifies false (115000 > 107000); a partially dated model answering
124000 would flip this case to true.
* percentage case (2019-06-01): base globals, date only. #ASSERT: limit
3000 under the pre-2021 'lesser of' shape. Surfaces as
the_applicable_measure_of_annual_income_or_net_worth = 60000 (lesser;
200000 under the base 2023 case) and qualifies false (5000 > 3000).
* A pair (2021-06-01 / 2019-06-01): global investor = A (accredited,
$200,000 already sold). #ASSERTs: within/NOT within — the accredited
carve-out did not exist before 2021-03-15. Surfaces as
the_accredited_investor_carve_out_applies_to true/false and qualifies
repeat issuer), amount = 2000 so the investor limb passes under the
2019 'lesser of' limit. #ASSERTs: audited / reviewed required.
Surfaces as financial_statement_requirement_is_satisfied false/true
against the base reviewed supply (2019: 550000 > tier 2 535000 and no
first-time relief for a repeat issuer) and qualifies false/true.
* COVID pair (both 2021-06-01): the window refusal is BANDED, not
blanket. Small: global offering = $100,000, supplied = certified;
#ASSERT certified suffices at or below tier 1 — qualifies true with
the requirement satisfied at assurance level 1. Large: global offering
= F; #ASSERT audited — $550,000 is above the $250,000 relief band, so
the ordinary tiers answer inside the window; requirement unsatisfied
by reviewed, qualifies false. Neither case enters the refusal band
(tier 1 < aggregate ≤ 250000), so the hydrated ASSUME sentinel for the
unmodelled temporary rules never surfaces — the refusal stays a
refusal.
WHAT IS DELIBERATELY PINNED 'WRONG' IN THE BASE CASE, because the MODEL is
the subject: four decisions diverge from L4-truth by exactly the loss
D-PARAM-AS-INPUT records (an un-lifted tier-1 callee reads the GLOBAL
input; the argument at the call site is discarded). Under the base case's
globals (the clean base-case world):
* the_delinquent_issuer_case_qualifies  = true   (L4: false — the
delinquent ISSUER argument is discarded; eligibility reads the global
clean issuer)
* the_short_availability_case_qualifies = true   (L4: false — the 20-day
ARRANGEMENT argument is discarded; the global arrangement has 21 days)
* the_under_assured_financials_case_qualifies = true (L4: false — the
700k previously-sold OFFERING argument is discarded by the disclosure
limb; the global offering needs only reviewed statements)
* the_over_limit_investor_case_qualifies = true (L4: false — MEASURED
2026-08-02, correcting this file's own earlier unmeasured claim that
the investor limb 'routes through BKM parameters, so the variation is
genuinely per-call'. The BKM does receive the per-call investor, but
the investment-limit limb's figures enter through the λ-LIFTED closure
parameters, bound `name: name` to the GLOBAL decisions (D-BKM, spec
§6.2): aggregate_amount_sold_..._including_this_transaction is the
global 0 + 5000 = 5000, within the global investor's 10,000 limit, so
the model answers true while L4's per-call 9000 + 5000 = 14000 answers
false. Derived from the documented lowering, confirmed on both
engines).
The quartet is the corpus-scale exhibit of §2.1's and §6.2's ruled trades:
four for four, the model diverges where the lowering discards or
globalises a per-call argument. In the RELOCATION cases the same lowering
makes all five `*_case_qualifies` pins equal by construction (see above),
and each is pinned to the L4-evaluated qualification of the case's
GLOBAL world — the documented transform applied to a different world, not
a value read off an engine.
THE VERDICT PIN (R13), and how it was anchored — to L4 plus the documented
transform, never to the DMN's own evaluated output:
(i)   guard truths from L4: `ongoing reporting obligation may terminate`
is true under this context (status: 1 annual report filed AND 200 <
300 holders of record satisfies (b)(2), regcf.l4:657-663), already
pinned above as ongoing_reporting_obligation_may_terminate = true;
(ii)  arm selection from the L4 source ordering (regcf.l4:708-709): the
chain is first-match and the may-terminate row is row 1, so
annual_cycles = 2 never reaches row 2;
(iii) the string constructed BY HAND from verdictOf's spec'd definition
(spec §16.1) BEFORE any engine ran: MUST arm, no HENCE, so the
verdict is the action's declared name verbatim —
'file a Form C-TR termination of reporting'.
The reporting spine and transfer decisions read only status/status_2/
annual_cycles/transfer, none of which any relocation case touches, so
their pins are identical in all 16 cases.
The 10 BKMs (the rules in force include, offering is within the offering
limit, investment limit, investor is within the investment limit,
financial statements required, assurance level, the transaction qualifies
for the section 4(a)(6) exemption, an offering of, an investor with, an
arrangement with) are not named in expect: a businessKnowledgeModel is a
function, not a decision — the cases schema's recorded limitation (spec
§13.6) — and each is asserted through its callers above.
